name: steal_gil_bribe
description: Pilfer Gil (pp_BtlStealGil): the chance on the target, the amount formula and the halving; Bribe (pp_BtlBribe): the chance from gil paid and offered, immunity, the Eject, the counters and the build-language special case.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions; only the battle RNG function is replaced by a script (rngDraws is what the game asked for)

notes: in.fn is the kernel function; in.args its plain arguments. stealItem: user [autoB], target [stealCount, lastAttacker], loot [chance, commonId, rareId, commonQty, rareQty] or null. stealGil: target [gil-steal chance, signed 16 bit], factor (loot byte +0x113), hasLoot. bribe: cmd (misc word), target {maxHp, paid, special, monster, marker, value}, rec {sleep, extra}, counters [success, immune, fail].
in.g: mode (0x112c9e5), hit (0x112a90a), rare (0x112a911), lang (language id), rikku (counter 0x1130840), offered (gil offered, 0x112be90).

out: ret and what the function changed; blk is the result block bytes [attempted, quantity word, item word] (steal) or [attempted, amount] (gil). inv lists the party-inventory adds (the inventory function is replaced by a recorder), ach the achievement calls.
rngDraws: every draw the game made, in order, with its stream (10 and 11 are literal streams; the bribe uses the target mode-2 stream).
